title: Child Is Father To The Man
notes:
1st U.S. pressing, Pitman.

Tracklist on labels starts below the spindle hole. (Compare to [url=http://www.discogs.com/Blood-Sweat-And-Tears-Child-Is-Father-To-The-Man/release/7717011]r7717011[/url])
This release on 1965-70 red Columbia labels with "⇦”360 SOUND” STEREO “360 SOUND”⇨" at bottom printed in white.

"Produced by John Simon* for Past, Present and Future Productions, Inc."
John Simon - General overseer, production, string arrangements and horn arrangement criticisms.  Also plays organ and piano at will.

Artist name appears as "Blood, Sweat & Tears" on the front cover, and as "Blood, Sweat And Tears" on the back cover, spine and labels.

"PRINTED IN U.S.A." on spine, back cover and labels.

identifiers.description: A1 to A4, A6 to B6
Variant 4: A Side, Stamped except etched I and solo 3; the D is a partial stamping
Variant 4: B Side stamped except etched I and 17
Variant 5: A Side stamped except etched B 3
Variant 5: B Side stamped except etched 2

identifiers.value: o XSM135785-1E I P C D
identifiers.description: Variant 12: Side A stamped, except "I" etching
Variant 12: Side B stamped, except "I" etching
